title: Keepling export bundle manifest
description: manifest.json is written LAST inside the bundle, after every entity file, tasks.md, and FORMAT.md already exist on disk. A truncated or partially-written bundle therefore has no manifest.json and fails validation before any per-file digest is even checked. Readers key compatibility off export_format_version alone -- keepling_version and generated_at are provenance only, never a compatibility signal.

export_format_version.description: Standalone integer version of the archive format itself, decoupled from OpenAPI and protocol trains. Additive-only within a version; a version never ages out because it binds files already on a user's disk.

keepling_version.description: Provenance only -- readers must never use this for compatibility decisions.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 instant the export was generated. Provenance only, like keepling_version.

feed_high_water_sequence.description: The sync feed high-water sequence observed inside the export's own read transaction, making this bundle a citable point in the existing ordered sync feed.

restore_epoch.description: The restore epoch observed inside the export transaction, or null if no epoch has ever been finalized. Explicit null rather than omission, since absent and empty must stay distinguishable.

path.description: Path relative to the bundle root, e.g. data/task.ndjson, FORMAT.md, tasks.md.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact file bytes.

rowCount.description: Number of NDJSON lines for a data/*.ndjson file. For FORMAT.md and tasks.md this records the line count of the rendered document, never null or omitted -- absent and empty must remain distinguishable throughout the bundle.
